lessons.title: Dynamic Routes Basics
lessons.description: Create pages that adapt to any parameter like /posts/123 using [id].js and the useRouter hook.

lessons.title: Catch‑All Routes
lessons.description: Handle multiple URL segments with [...slug].js – ideal for nested categories or file browsers.

lessons.title: Optional Catch‑All Routes
lessons.description: Make catch‑all routes that also match the parent path with [[...slug]].js for ultimate flexibility.

lessons.title: Introduction to API Routes
lessons.description: Write server‑side code right inside your Next.js app. Create your first endpoint in pages/api.

lessons.title: API Routes Deep Dive
lessons.description: Handle different HTTP methods, parse request bodies and query strings, and send proper responses.

lessons.title: Connecting Frontend to API
lessons.description: Fetch data from your own API routes using client‑side code, SWR, and HTML forms.
